shortBio.en: Pearl Jam frontman; baritone on Ten-era Alive and Jeremy.
shortBio.zh: Pearl Jam 主唱；Ten 时期 Alive 与 Jeremy 上的男中音。

body.en:
Born 1964. Joins Gossard/Ament/McCready 1990. Baritone forward on Ten; anti-star interview posture beside stadium scale. Remains continuous vocal seat through drum rotations.

Lyric narratives (Alive, Jeremy) define debut radio face.
body.zh:
1964 年生。1990 加入 Gossard/Ament/McCready。Ten 上男中音靠前；体育场体量旁的反明星访谈姿态。鼓席轮换下人声席连续。

叙事歌词（Alive、Jeremy）定义出道电台面孔。
